Changes made to `0.html`:

1. Added a `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS media query so animations stay paused even if JavaScript fails to load (progressive enhancement, not just a JS-only guard).
2. Made the reduced-motion preference reactive — if the user toggles their OS-level setting while the page is open, the circle now pauses/resumes and the label updates live, instead of only checking once at page load.

No other issues found — the accessibility labeling, speed-cycling, and animation-restart logic were already solid.
